messages:
Priya K: Quick sync — postmortem for incident #426 is up (https://redwood/postmortems/incident-426). We need to hand off remediation owners, update dedupe rules, and lock timelines. Can we confirm owners and EOW targets?
Alex M: +1. I can own dedupe changes. Will open a PR and add unit tests.
Sam: I’ll take threshold tuning for the Redis alerts (high churn). Need baseline traffic windows/logs to pick safe percentiles.
Priya K: @Alex M please use alerting/dedupe repo and include a short migration plan for existing rules. Add a changelog entry.
Alex M: On it — branch name: fix/dedupe-rotation-247. Will PR by Thu.
Oncall Bot: Incident #426 closed — postmortem published: https://redwood/postmortems/incident-426 (autogenerated)
Morgan: Can we add a recurring runbook check so these regressions don’t come back? Suggest monthly alert sweeps and a checklist for owners.
DevEx: I can spin up a dashboard showing dedupe hit-rate, page volume, and suppression events. ETA next Tue.
Sam: For thresholds proposal: staggered backoffs — primary at 90p, secondary at 95p, and suppression trigger after 3 repeats within 10m. I’ll prototype in APM sandbox.
Priya K: Owners & timeline recap: Alex — dedupe PR by Thu; Sam — threshold prototype by Fri; DevEx — dashboard by Tue; Morgan — runbook cadence proposal by Mon. I’ll add these to the action tracker and link to the postmortem.
Alex M: quick question — do we want auto-scaling suppression windows? could risk hiding genuine incidents.
Sam: prefer fixed cooldowns with gradual backoff, not open-ended suppression.
Priya K: Agreed. Playbook rule: suppression <= 1h unless manually extended with incident lead signoff. I’ll author the clause.
DevEx: Draft dashboard created: https://grafana/d/abc123/alert-tuning (shared with team)
Priya K: Great — thanks. I’ll update the postmortem and sprint board, and ping owners during standup. :thumbsup:
Oncall Bot: Reminder scheduled: monthly alert-sweep created on calendar for #ops — 2026-04-01 10:00 UTC
Morgan: Noted. Closing this thread once PRs/artefacts are linked in the tracker.
